chapters.heading: You Are The Fish
chapters.body: Reach the stairwell while avoiding the ghost's traps.

chapters.heading: Move
chapters.body: A / D or arrow keys walk. Gamepad: left stick.

chapters.heading: Run
chapters.body: Hold Shift to run. Gamepad: click the left stick.

chapters.heading: Jump
chapters.body: Space jumps from the ground. Gamepad: A.

chapters.heading: Clear The Traps
chapters.body: Run and jump over obstacles. A cart can move; a chandelier can fall.

chapters.heading: Look Into The Dark
chapters.body: Move your mouse to aim the spotlight. Watch the floor and ceiling.

chapters.heading: The Stairwell
chapters.body: Reach the door, then press E. Gamepad: X. This starts the ghost challenge.

chapters.heading: Watch Your Spook
chapters.body: Moving or active traps raise spook on contact. At 100, you become the ghost; the old ghost takes your fish body.

chapters.heading: Ready For The Round
chapters.body: Read your role page and choose Ready. Everyone must be ready, then the ghost has a 10-second setup before you move.

chapters.heading: You Are The Ghost
chapters.body: Use traps to spook the fish. Packages arrive on the conveyor above the hallway.

chapters.heading: Fly
chapters.body: WASD or arrow keys flies in two dimensions. Gamepad: left stick.

chapters.heading: Open A Package
chapters.body: Fly close to a package and press E. Gamepad: X. You now carry its trap.

chapters.heading: Carry It To The Hallway
chapters.body: Fly down to a clear floor space. You cannot place over another trap or a fish.

chapters.heading: The Safe Hallway
chapters.body: The starting hallway forbids trap footprints and cart travel.

chapters.heading: Place
chapters.body: With a valid floor preview, press E / X to place the held trap.

chapters.heading: Possess
chapters.body: Fly near your placed trap and press E / X to control it.

chapters.heading: Shopping Cart
chapters.body: While possessed, A / D or left stick moves the cart. It collides with the real hallway and bodies.

chapters.heading: Unpossess
chapters.body: E / X releases control so you can fly again.

chapters.heading: Falling Chandelier
chapters.body: Carry a chandelier. Aim at a clear ceiling position with the mouse within reach, then E / X places it.

chapters.heading: Drop It
chapters.body: Possess the chandelier, then press Space. Gamepad: A. Time the drop as a fish passes.

chapters.heading: Reset
chapters.body: F resets a controlled trap if its reset position is clear. Gamepad: B.

chapters.heading: Click Trap
chapters.body: Possess the stationary click trap. Click its body to activate it; it does not drive like the cart.

chapters.heading: Dispose
chapters.body: Q discards a held trap or removes the trap you are currently possessing.

chapters.heading: Spook And Role Swap
chapters.body: Moving or active traps raise spook on contact. At 100, the fish becomes the ghost and you take its fish body.

chapters.heading: Ready And Setup
chapters.body: Choose Ready on your role page. Once everyone is ready, use your 10-second setup before the fish is released.

Ghost.note: Archived Ghost footage ends during drop; later mechanics are explained by cards.
